traits.ovary_position.note: DELTA, Nelumbonaceae (read 2026-10-16): ovary superior, with 'inferior' given only as an alternative reading of the separate carpels sunk into the spongy receptacle; the family is one genus, so the even tie becomes the primary reading.

traits.flower_merosity.note: APweb, Proteales page, Nelumbonaceae (read 2026-10-16): sepals 2-4, petals 10-30 spiral; merosity weak.

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Proteales page, Nelumbonaceae (read 2026-10-16): large flowers of 10-30 petals; bowl form inferred.

traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Nelumbonaceae: leaves simple; veins palmate; stipules present; leaf rosettes none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior or inferior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals or spiral; fruit nut; stamens 200 to 400; carpels 12 to 40. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 291, 293, family Nelumbonaceae: leaf arrangement alternate, spiral; read as "alternate".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 291, 293, family Nelumbonaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 291, 293, family Nelumbonaceae: rhizome habit long_creeping; read as "long_creeping".

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Nelumbonaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded usually a rhizome. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
